matches.preview: Wrexham and Birmingham contest a finely balanced fixture. The model marginally favours the home side at 39%, with the draw positioned at 29% and Birmingham's chances at 33%. In their recent meeting Birmingham won 2-0 away, though they drew 1-1 at Wrexham earlier. Both clubs return after their previous campaigns ended differently: Wrexham's season finished with a 2-2 draw at home, while Birmingham closed unbeaten. The model leans towards under 2.5 goals at 52%, suggesting a tightly contested low-scoring affair.

In recent head-to-head meetings Swansea hold a marginal advantage in results. The model expects a low-scoring encounter, leaning towards under 2.5 goals at 54%.

matches.preview: Middlesbrough are favoured at 54% to win, with draw chances at 25% and West Bromwich Albion at 21%. The key factor underlying this is the hosts' head-to-head record: Middlesbrough have won all five recent meetings with Albion, including 3-2 in January. Both teams finished their seasons with mixed results, combining victories and draws. Middlesbrough won twice in their final six matches, while West Bromwich Albion also showed inconsistent form, recording multiple clean sheets alongside a late defeat. The goal market is evenly split between over and under 2.5 goals.

Wolverhampton are clear favourites at 63%, holding superior pedigree despite a difficult end to last season in the Premier League. Their final campaign showed inconsistency with draws but concerning away defeats. Stoke finished the previous Championship season weakly, recording just one draw across six matches with five losses. The marked contrast in recent form supports the model's lean toward Wolverhampton. No prior meetings between the teams exist to reference patterns. The forecast rates over 2.5 goals at 54%, marginally favouring higher-scoring play.

Blackburn are favoured at 42% to secure victory, though the 28% probability of a draw reflects a notably competitive matchup between these two sides. Both clubs finished the previous campaign with disappointing form: the home side mixed defeats with draws, whilst Queens Park Rangers endured a worrying run of heavy losses. Their head-to-head shows alternating results, with Blackburn claiming victory in the most recent meeting. The total-goals model leans towards under 2.5 at 54%, suggesting limited scoring is most probable.

Bolton's recorded form dates from 2019, now historical, with the club returning to Championship level after an extended absence from the top two divisions. Lincoln City has no recent matches on record. With no previous meetings to draw on, the model leans marginally towards under 2.5 goals at 53%.

Bristol City are favoured at 44%, though the 28% for Portsmouth and 28% for a draw indicate this is a close contest. The model reflects Bristol City's strong recent head-to-head dominance, notably a 5-0 victory in January, though both sides showed mixed form across last season's final stretch. Portsmouth won four of their last six fixtures; Bristol City secured just two from six. The match is expected to be lower-scoring, with under 2.5 goals favoured at 54%.

Norwich City are marginal favourites at 39% to Burnley's 33%, though the 27% draw probability indicates a closely matched encounter. Burnley return to the Championship after Premier League football, their recent top-flight form showing four losses and two draws from six matches. Norwich's own campaign in this division closed with three wins and two defeats from their last six games. However, Burnley hold a decisive edge in their head-to-head record, winning three of the last five meetings. The model leans slightly towards over 2.5 goals, at 52%, suggesting an open affair.

This is competitively balanced, with Cardiff marginally favoured at 37% to Sheffield United's 36%, though a 27% draw remains realistic. Cardiff return to this level after seasons in lower divisions, whereas Sheffield United have maintained their status. The head-to-head record strongly favours the visitors, with Sheffield United winning four of the last five meetings, most recently in April 2025. The model suggests over 2.5 goals at 54%, though the lean is modest, reflecting the genuine uncertainty of this fixture.

Charlton Athletic enter as slight favourites with the model backing them at 42%, though the outcome is finely balanced with both a draw and Preston at 29% each. Preston enjoy a strong recent record, having won both league meetings last season, including a 2-0 home victory before prevailing 2-1 away in the spring. Both sides struggled through the campaign's closing weeks: Charlton recorded a home win over Hull but suffered three losses in their final six matches, whilst Preston showed similar volatility with a 3-2 away victory at Sheffield United but successive defeats at home. The model suggests a lower-scoring match is more likely, with under 2.5 goals assessed at 57%.

The model gives Southampton a narrow edge at 49%, but this is finely balanced with Millwall at 25% and the draw at 27%. Southampton return to this level after a mixed finish to last season, when home matches saw them held to successive 2-2 draws against Ipswich and Bristol City. Millwall showed stronger form at the campaign's close, taking three points at home to Oxford and claiming a victory away at Stoke. The head-to-head record favours Millwall, who have won two of the last four meetings. Goals look evenly balanced, with the over 2.5 at 52% only marginally favoured over the under.

West Ham are strongly favoured with a 51% probability compared to Watford's 23%, with a 25% probability for a draw. Their recent meeting record shows West Ham winning all five recent encounters, with four of those victories coming by two or more goals. Watford returns after a recent period of poor form, having lost four of their final five league matches. West Ham's previous campaign also ended with mixed results overall. The total-goals model leans towards over 2.5 at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: West Ham 的獲勝機率為 51%，相比之下 Watford 為 23%，平手機率為 25%。雙方近五次交手中，West Ham 全部獲勝，其中四場勝利達到兩球以上。Watford 最近狀態欠佳，最後五場聯賽中輸掉四場。West Ham 上一賽季戰績好壞參半。總進球數模型傾向超過 2.5 球，機率為 57%。
